title: Completely Positive Reformulations of Polynomial Optimization Problems with Linear Inequality Constraints
summary: Polynomial optimization encompasses a broad class of problems in which both the objective function and constraints are polynomial functions of the decision variables. In recent years, a substantial body of research has focused on reformulating polynomial optimization problems (POPs) as conic programs over the cone of completely positive tensors (CPTs). In this article, we propose several new completely positive reformulations for a class of POPs with linear inequality constraints.
